clue.text: Partner to dash round record storage site

indicators.note: round says the first piece goes around the second, enclosing it

parts.note: dot and dash go together in Morse code, so the dot partners the dash
EP is an extended-play record

explanation.surface: Someone hurries round with a record to a place where it will be stored.
explanation.definitionFit: A depot is a warehouse or place where goods are kept for later use.

clue.text: Big tirade put out with no end of ranting?

definitions.text: Big tirade put out with no end of ranting?

indicators.note: put out here means disordered or displaced, telling us to rearrange the letters of the two words
with no tells us a letter is missing from the rearranged pool
end of picks the final letter of the word ranting

explanation.surface: A huge rant is delivered, though it oddly lacks its final flourish.
explanation.walkthrough: Rearrange BIGTIRADE after removing the G that 'end of ranting' supplies; 'put out' signals the rearrangement and 'with no' the loss. The whole clue also describes a long angry speech.
explanation.definitionFit: A diatribe is a forceful verbal attack, exactly a big tirade of ranting.

clue.text: Annoying person defending nonsense in demonstration

indicators.note: defending pictures one piece surrounding and shielding the other

parts.note: a pest is a nuisance of a person
rot is a word for rubbish or nonsense

explanation.surface: An irritating heckler stands up for some nonsense during a street march.
explanation.definitionFit: A protest is a public demonstration of objection, a march or rally.

clue.text: Drink close to park in wood

parts.note: tea is a common drink

indicators.note: close to means the end of, so the final letter of park

explanation.surface: Having a cup of tea near the park in some woodland.
explanation.definitionFit: Teak is a hard tropical timber used in furniture and boatbuilding.

clue.text: Obscure muscles displayed by acrobat's last trick

parts.note: abs is short for abdominal muscles

indicators.note: last picks the final letter of the word acrobat's

parts.note: a ruse is a trick or deception

explanation.surface: An acrobat shows off a six-pack in a baffling final stunt.
explanation.definitionFit: Abstruse means hard to understand, so it is a close synonym of obscure.

clue.text: Unusually beloved nun fears rejecting a timid type

indicators.note: unusually means in an odd way, signalling that the letters are rearranged
rejecting says the letter a is thrown out of the rearranged pool

explanation.surface: A cherished nun is unusually fearful and turns down something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Unusually' rearranges BELOVEDNUNFEARS and 'rejecting' throws out its A, leaving fourteen letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A bundle of nerves is an idiom for a very anxious, jumpy person.

clue.text: Pull shown by Northern community

parts.note: to tow is to pull along

explanation.surface: A northern settlement shows its pulling power.
explanation.definitionFit: A town is a settled community of people, larger than a village.

clue.text: Metal found in heart of crust

definitions.text: Metal found in heart of crust

parts.words: Metal found in heart of crust
parts.note: a radioactive heavy metal mined from ore deep in the earth's rocky outer layer

explanation.surface: A geology note about a metal located deep inside the earth's rocky shell.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'crust' sounds like pastry, but this is the earth's crust; the radioactive element is mined from ore found there.
explanation.definitionFit: Uranium is a metallic element occurring naturally in rocks of the earth's crust.

clue.text: Correct pieces penned by journalist

indicators.note: penned by means enclosed inside, as in a pen, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: ED is short for editor, a newspaper journalist
men are the pieces in chess or draughts

explanation.surface: An editor writes up some articles and puts them right.
explanation.definitionFit: To emend is to correct a text by removing errors.

clue.text: Decorator ruing working in very strong material

indicators.note: working means being worked over or put into action, telling us to rework the letters

explanation.surface: A decorator regrets labouring with some tough building stuff.
explanation.definitionFit: Corrugated iron is sheet metal pressed into ridges for added rigidity, a strong roofing material.

clue.text: A largely outspoken party of greenish hue

indicators.note: largely means most of it, so the last letter of the synonym is dropped

parts.note: vocal means outspoken, expressing views freely
a do is a party or social event

explanation.surface: A vocal political party with a greenish colour scheme.
explanation.definitionFit: Avocado is a colour name for the dull yellowish-green of the fruit's flesh.

clue.text: Reportedly recognised gesture in avant-garde group

indicators.note: reportedly means as it is said or heard, so we need a word sounding like the synonym

parts.note: knew means recognised or was aware of
a wave is a hand gesture

explanation.surface: A greeting supposedly acknowledged among a group of experimental artists.
explanation.definitionFit: The new wave is a movement breaking with tradition, as in French cinema or late-1970s music.

clue.text: Official covering English bank

indicators.note: covering means the first piece goes over and around the second

parts.note: a ref, short for referee, is a sports official

explanation.surface: A referee shields an English riverside.
explanation.definitionFit: A reef is a ridge of rock or sand near the water's surface, a sandbank or bar.

clue.text: Retired peer with line that's comical

indicators.note: retired means drawn back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: a lord is a peer of the realm

explanation.surface: A retired aristocrat with a funny line.
explanation.definitionFit: Droll means amusing in a dry, odd way, so it is a synonym of comical.

clue.text: Helpful sort

definitions.meaning: as an adjective, considerate and generous to others
as a noun, a type or variety

explanation.surface: A description of a person who is always willing to help.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both considerate (adjective) and a type or class (noun).

clue.text: Wine container, say, overturned in indulgent bout

parts.note: a bin is a rack or store for wine bottles

indicators.note: overturned in a down clue means turned upside down, read backwards

parts.note: eg (for example) is what 'say' means

explanation.surface: A wine rack knocked over during a drinking session.
explanation.definitionFit: A binge is a spell of excessive self-indulgence, typically eating or drinking.

clue.text: Uncover set of cartoons

definitions.meaning: as a verb, to remove a covering or bare
a comic sequence of drawn panels in a newspaper

explanation.surface: Revealing a series of cartoon drawings.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to strip bare and a comic strip of cartoon panels.

clue.text: Good to wear it on beach — must when swimming!

definitions.text: Good to wear it on beach — must when swimming!

indicators.note: swimming means moving about freely, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: Advice that this garment is a must for wearing on the beach when going for a dip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when swimming' mixes G (good) with ITONBEACHMUST; the whole clue also describes the garment.
explanation.definitionFit: A bathing costume is a swimsuit, the thing you wear on the beach to swim.

clue.text: Bully tired after start of belligerent argument

indicators.note: after places the synonym for tired at the end
start of picks the first letter of the word belligerent

parts.note: a row is a noisy argument
beat means exhausted or tired

explanation.surface: An exhausted bully after the opening of an aggressive quarrel.
explanation.definitionFit: To browbeat is to intimidate someone with stern words or threats, a verb sense of bully.

clue.text: Set of steps to manoeuvre for crew member

parts.note: a flight is a series of stairs
to engineer is to contrive or manoeuvre a result

explanation.surface: Arranging a staircase for one of the workers.
explanation.definitionFit: A flight engineer is an aircrew member who monitors the plane's systems.

clue.text: Go miles off course in French city

indicators.note: off course means straying from the route, so the letters wander into a new order

explanation.surface: Travelling miles off route while in France.
explanation.definitionFit: Limoges is a city in west-central France famous for porcelain.

clue.text: Improve two bridge players with luck initially deficient

parts.note: in bridge the players are named by compass points, here East and North

indicators.note: initially deficient means lacking its first letter

parts.note: chance means luck or fortune

explanation.surface: Two card players hope to do better when luck is lacking at the start.
explanation.definitionFit: To enhance is to improve the quality or value of something.

clue.text: Exotic sport backed in boom usually

indicators.note: backed says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A foreign sport supported during a usual period of boom.
explanation.definitionFit: Sumo is Japanese wrestling, a sport that seems exotic to Western eyes.

clue.text: Something sweet in your short parting drink

indicators.note: parting means splitting apart, so the drink is opened up to take the other piece

parts.note: to sup is to drink
yr is the short written form of your

explanation.surface: A sweet cordial served as your farewell drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Syrup is a thick sweet liquid, something sweet poured over food.

clue.text: Dress creating fuss before service

indicators.note: before places the fuss piece ahead of the service

parts.note: ado is fuss or bother
RN is the Royal Navy, one of the armed services

explanation.surface: A garment causing a stir ahead of a church service.
explanation.definitionFit: To adorn is to decorate or dress up, as a verb.

clue.text: Nut without a second piece of tobacco

indicators.note: without means lacking, so these letters are taken out

parts.note: a cashew is a kind of nut

explanation.surface: A nut, then quickly a plug of tobacco.
explanation.definitionFit: A chew is a wad of tobacco held in the mouth and chewed rather than smoked.

clue.text: Choice fruit

definitions.meaning: as an adjective, the best or most desirable
a stone fruit, purple or yellow

explanation.surface: Selecting a piece of fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a stone fruit and, as an adjective, a highly desirable job or role.

clue.text: Row of listening devices turned up

indicators.note: turned up in a down clue means read from the bottom upwards, backwards

parts.note: taps are bugs placed on telephone lines

explanation.surface: An argument about bugging equipment being discovered.
explanation.definitionFit: A spat is a petty quarrel, which is one sense of row.

clue.text: Customer that's habitually appearing in periodical

definitions.meaning: a patron who keeps coming back to the same shop or pub
as an adjective, recurring at fixed intervals

explanation.surface: A frequent shopper who turns up in a magazine.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a frequent patron and recurring at even intervals.

clue.text: Vessels entering river in huge area

indicators.note: entering means going inside, so one piece sits within the other

parts.note: the Exe is a river in Devon, south-west England
pans are cooking vessels

explanation.surface: Boats sailing into a river across a vast area.
explanation.definitionFit: An expanse is a wide continuous area of land, sea or sky.

clue.text: Old man in sham woolly shawl

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father, your old man

indicators.note: woolly means fuzzy or muddled, telling us to jumble the letters

explanation.surface: A father wearing a fake woollen wrap.
explanation.definitionFit: A pashmina is a shawl made from fine goat-wool cashmere.

clue.text: Affectedly pretty type's first to use social medium

parts.note: twee means excessively dainty or quaint

indicators.note: first picks the opening letter of the word type's

explanation.surface: A sentimental sort being the first to post online.
explanation.definitionFit: To tweet is to post a short message on the social platform formerly called Twitter.
